title: 2-Butoxytetrahydrofuran, Isolated from Holothuria scabra, Attenuates Aggregative and Oxidative Properties of alpha-Synuclein and Alleviates Its Toxicity in a Transgenic Caenorhabditis elegans Model of Parkinson's Disease.
authors: Promtang, Sukrit; Sanguanphun, Tanatcha; Chalorak, Pawanrat; Pe, Laurence S; Niamnont, Nakorn; Sobhon, Prasert; Meemon, Krai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物2-BTHF对α-突触核蛋白聚集和毒性的缓解作用，仅涉及分子对接预测与转录因子HSF-1/DAF-16的潜在结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aggregative alpha-synuclein and incurring oxidative stress are pivotal cascading events, leading to dopaminergic (DAergic) neuronal loss and contributing to clinical manifestations of Parkinson's disease (PD). Our previous study demonstrated that 2-butoxytetrahydrofuran (2-BTHF), isolated from Holothuria scabra (H. scabra), could inhibit amyloid-beta aggregation and its ensuing toxicity, which leads to Alzheimer's disease. In the present study, we found that 2-BTHF also attenuated the aggregative and oxidative activities of alpha-synuclein and lessened its toxicity in a transgenic Caenorhabditis elegans (C. elegans) PD model. Such worms treated with 100 muM of 2-BTHF showed substantial reductions in alpha-synuclein accumulation and DAergic neurodegeneration. Mechanistically, 2-BTHF, at this concentration, significantly decreased aggregation of monomeric alpha-synuclein and restored locomotion and dopamine-dependent behaviors. Molecular docking exhibited potential bindings of 2-BTHF to HSF-1 and DAF-16 transcription factors. Additionally, 2-BTHF significantly increased the mRNA transcripts of genes encoding proteins involved in proteostasis, including the molecular chaperones hsp-16.2 and hsp-16.49, the ubiquitination/SUMOylation-related ubc-9 gene, and the autophagy-related genes atg-7 and lgg-1. Transcriptomic profiling revealed an additional mechanism of 2-BTHF in alpha-synuclein-expressing worms, which showed upregulation of PPAR signaling cascades that mediated fatty acid metabolism. 2-BTHF significantly restored lipid deposition, upregulated the fat-7 gene, and enhanced gcs-1-mediated glutathione synthesis in the C. elegans PD model. Taken together, this study demonstrated that 2-BTHF could abrogate aggregative and oxidative properties of alpha-synuclein and attenuate its toxicity, thus providing a possible therapeutic application for the treatment of alpha-synuclein-induced PD.
abstract_zh: α-突触核蛋白（alpha-synuclein）的聚集及随之引发的氧化应激是关键级联事件，导致多巴胺能（DAergic）神经元损失，并促成帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）的临床表现。我们先前的研究表明，从糙海参（Holothuria scabra, H. scabra）中分离出的2-丁氧基四氢呋喃（2-butoxytetrahydrofuran, 2-BTHF）能抑制导致阿尔茨海默病的β-淀粉样蛋白聚集及其后续毒性。在本研究中，我们发现2-BTHF同样减弱了α-突触核蛋白的聚集和氧化活性，并在转基因秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans, C. elegans）PD模型中减轻了其毒性。用100 μM 2-BTHF处理的此类线虫显示出α-突触核蛋白积累和多巴胺能神经退行性变的显著减少。机制上，2-BTHF在此浓度下显著降低了单体α-突触核蛋白的聚集，并恢复了运动能力和多巴胺依赖性行为。分子对接显示2-BTHF与HSF-1和DAF-16转录因子存在潜在结合。此外，2-BTHF显著增加了编码参与蛋白质稳态相关蛋白的基因mRNA转录本，包括分子伴侣hsp-16.2和hsp-16.49、泛素化/SUMO化相关ubc-9基因，以及自噬相关基因atg-7和lgg-1。转录组分析揭示了2-BTHF在表达α-突触核蛋白线虫中的额外机制，显示其上调了介导脂肪酸代谢的PPAR信号级联。在C. elegans PD模型中，2-BTHF显著恢复了脂质沉积，上调了fat-7基因，并增强了gcs-1介导的谷胱甘肽合成。综上所述，本研究证明2-BTHF能消除α-突触核蛋白的聚集和氧化特性，并减轻其毒性，从而为治疗α-突触核蛋白诱导的PD提供了潜在的治疗应用。
